annotations.note: 9M26 rev TRY 1,174.1bn, NPAT TRY 122.1bn, Q3 margin $36.3/bbl, net cash TRY 165.4bn (up from TRY 57bn YE25).
100% of crude/refined product export proceeds flow directly into offshore collection accounts; debt service for international Eurobonds is deducted prior to any fiscal repatriation.
Low cash lifting cost ($8 - $18/boe) ensures robust operating profitability and positive cash flow even during severe oil price downturns ($50/bbl).
Proved plus probable commercial reserves provide a durable 12-18 year production life, underpinning long-dated senior paper.
Upgraded FY26 Net Refining Margin guidance to $20.0-$22.0/bbl (from $13.0-$15.0/bbl) after 9M NRM hit $23.0/bbl at 106% Q3 utilization; net cash intact.

verdict.stance: Overweight / Net-Cash Refining Leader on Record $36.3/bbl Q3 Cracks
verdict.summary: Tüpraş delivered blowout 9M26 results: revenue TRY 1,174.1bn, NPAT TRY 122.1bn, Q3 net refining margin $36.3/bbl (9M avg $23.0/bbl), and net cash ballooned to TRY 165.4bn (vs TRY 57.0bn YE25), leaving net leverage negative ahead of $532m YTD transition capex.

positives: Exceptional refining windfall: 9M26 NRM $23.0/bbl and 106% Q3 utilization; FY26 NRM guidance raised to $20-22/bbl (from $13-15/bbl).
Net cash fortress balance sheet comfortably covers ~$700m FY26 capex and dividends.
Dominant domestic Turkish refined products market share (~55%+).
negatives: Middle distillate crack spread cyclicality (normalization risk in 2027).
Turkish sovereign/FX & energy transition capex requirements.
IAS 29 hyperinflation accounting distorts nominal TRY YoY comparisons.

background.business_overview: Türkiye's sole major oil refiner operating four refineries (İzmit, İzmir, Kırıkkale, Batman) with ~30 Mt annual capacity.
background.asset_perimeter: Four domestic refineries, Entek renewables, Ditaş marine logistics, OPET stake.
background.ownership_governance: Controlled by Koç Holding & Entek/partner; BIST-listed (TUPRS).
